labeling_policy: Labels are assigned from current research scope and source jurisdiction before running the candidate RAG arms.
Municipal answers are not used as national regulatory ground truth.
When municipality context is implicit only because the query came from a municipal Q&A page, evaluation_question minimally restores that context.
No case was deleted or replaced to improve class balance.

suitability.reason: The batch is dominated by municipality-specific comprehensive-care and pre-application questions, so it mainly tests LOCAL / scope gating rather than verified Claim retrieval.
